name: Keep moving between steps
description: Three steps with Keep moving into the next step on, then a boomerang that stops. The run takes 6.85 s; with every step stopping it takes 9.48 s. The drive is capped at 6 V so it hands off at 42 in/s. At 12 V it hands off at 76 in/s and the arc runs 7.2 in wide and 29° past its heading. The arc has a 4 V Min voltage, the least the drive gets until the handoff. The cost is accuracy between steps: the arc hands off 2.8 in and 9.4° from its target. The last step still ends 0.2 in off.

steps.note: at 6 V, so the arc starts at a speed it can hold
never under 4 V, so it does not slow to a crawl at the end
